prompts: Finance has to chase June's receivables. The invoices, the bank statement and our reconciliation notes are in {WS}/backoffice. What do we still have to collect or fix? Record it in {WS}/result.json: unpaid and duplicated (invoice ids) and mismatched (id, invoiced, paid).

[goal] Reconcile June receivables

[action] Recorded the results in [result.json](<WORKSPACE>/result.json). I treated bank memo invoice references as identifying payments, and ignored unidentifiable transfers, fees, and interest as the notes direct.

[result] Unpaid: INV-1008, INV-1030, INV-1033. Duplicated: INV-1015. Mismatched: INV-1021 (invoiced 21320.36, paid 21070.36) and INV-1036 (invoiced 8619.16, paid 7757.24). I parsed the JSON successfully and checked the invoice/payment classifications against all 40 invoices.

[next] No further action.
